$comment: Existing seeds that deviate from the current contract. The validator tolerates only the exact file, JSON pointer and violation recorded here, reports each exception on every run, and fails if an exception becomes stale. These entries are for pre-existing content only; new content must conform. Supported kinds: missing-property, empty-field, wrong-type and enum.

exceptions.reason: An order-format question from the June 2026 paper whose step list was not captured when the paper was transcribed. Do not invent the steps; re-transcribe them from the paper.
20 of its 40 practice questions have an empty explanation, so the learner sees nothing on reveal. Write the explanations (verify each answer while doing so), then delete this entry.
19 of its 25 practice questions have an empty explanation. Write them (recompute each figure), then delete this entry.
